identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit: 'Community School For Creative Education', Oakland, CA, EIN 26-3964588 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer)

The organization's own website describes a no-tuition charter school (nav lists 'Charter Renewal 21-26') at 2111 International Blvd, Oakland, CA, matching an OUSD Office of Charter Schools facilities agreement
Website says the school closed after 16 years of operation (opened 2011), so the 2024-2027 agreement in the agenda may relate to a school that has since closed
